tenderSchedule.title: RFP FOR SELECTION OF AN AGENCY TO PROVIDE MANAGED SECURITY SERVICE PARTNER FOR KARNATAKA STATE DATA CENTERS SECURITY OPERATION CENTER (SOC) AT BENGALURU
tenderSchedule.description: RFP FOR SELECTION OF AN AGENCY TO PROVIDE MANAGED SECURITY SERVICE PARTNER FOR KARNATAKA STATE DATA CENTERS SECURITY OPERATION CENTER (SOC) AT BENGALURU

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Room no 252, gate no 2, M S Building 2nd floor

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder must be a company registered in India under companies Act/Limited Liability partnership act and should have been in operation for a period of at least 5 years as on bid date. (Consortium formed for the purpose of this project are not eligible to bid for this project. Trusts and societies are also not eligible to bid for this project)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Certificate of Incorporation / Certificate of Partnership

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: A. The bidder should have experience in Implementing / Managing at least one SOC project for Data centers of Central/State Government /Public Sector BFSI Companies/ Enterprise of worth Rs. 9 Crore or two projects of Rs. 4.5 Crore or three projects with Rs. 3 Crore each during in last 7 years as on bid submission date. B. SOC Operations must have included SIEM managing and Monitoring of minimum 3000 Servers in virtualized environment and 50 Network and Perimeter Security devices in a single Data Center and providing SOC services covering SIEM, SOAR/NDR, PAM, UEBA, EDR/XDR for minimum period of one year. C. The bidder shall hold the valid empanelment with CERT-In as of bid submission date D. The bidder should have experience of Managing SIEM with at least 20000 EPS

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The related document Refer RFP

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidders company must have average annual financial turnover of Rs. 18 crores from SOC services during last three financial years (2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder company should have a positive net worth for each of the last three financial years i.e 2022-23, 2023-24 and 2024-25

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder should not have filed for bankruptcy.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Declaration in this regard by the authorized signatory of the bidder should be attached.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should have at least one permanent/working office in Bengaluru.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-Certificate issued by the HR head/Authorized signatory of the bidder organization.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should not have been blacklisted by the Government of India or any state government or any of its agencies for any reasons whatsoever and the bidder should not have been blacklisted by Central / any other State/UT Government or its agencies for indulging in corrupt or fraudulent practices or for indulging in unfair trade practices as on last date of bidding for this tender

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Undertaking from the Company Secretary or the Authorized Signatory.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have Technical Resource minimum 30 resources on roll of the company with experience in SOC technology and practices. resources must have certification like CISSP/CEH/CISA/CISM.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- An undertaking/declaration in company letter head by HR head of bidders company along with EPF document of the resources and their certificates.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder company must have a valid accredited ISO 9001:2015 for providing cyber-Defense services covering MSSP services & ISO 20000:2018 & ISO 27001:2022 certification
The signatory for this RFP must be authorized by Board or Head of the Organization

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Authorization letter by Board or Head of Organization or Power of Attorney document
